13652-exposition-of-the-apostles-creed.description: A book by The Rev. James Dodds, D.D.. A history of the Creed has not been attempted. There is much that is interesting in its origin and growth. pmc-13316962.description: Species' habitat utilization reflects their habitat preferences and activity patterns. pmc-13367359.creator: Long Jin, Xiaolei Zhang, Huailong Jiang, Qijian Li, Weinan Liu, Jiayao Wang, Zheyu Cao, Yuqin Liu
pmc-13367359.description: PurposeTo assess the efficacy and safety of delamani (Dlm), bedaquiline (Bdq) and linezolid (Lzd) in multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) and rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (RR-TB).Patients and MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed the clinical data of 71 patients with MDR/RR-TB. All patients were given a 6–9 month short-course treatment based on Dlm, Bdq and Lzd.

pmc-13379947.title: Surgical Intervention and Treatment of a Mammary Adenocarcinoma in the Sugar Glider (Petaurus breviceps): A Double Case Report
pmc-13379947.creator: Taryn Peña, Zoë Tormollen
pmc-13379947.description: A 6‐year‐old, intact female sugar glider (Petaurus breviceps) presented for evaluation after experiencing progressive weight loss and lethargy. Sedated examination revealed a firm, 7‐mm wide marsupium mass, and surgery was pursued after cytology results suggested epithelial malignancy. The patient′s entire marsupium was surgically excised, and biopsy of the associated tumor revealed a primary mammary adenocarcinoma without vascular infiltration.

uslaw-usc-t25-s323.title: 25 U.S.C. § 323 — Rights-of-way for all purposes across any Indian lands
uslaw-usc-t25-s323.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s323.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 8 (Rights-Of-Way Through Indian Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior be, and he is empowered to grant rights-of-way for all purposes, subject to such conditions as he may prescribe, over and across any lands now or hereafter held in trust by the United States for individual Indians or Indian tribes.
